title: Please add a note to the following two xDrip releases
symptom: Two xDrip releases from November 15 and November 26, 2020 are work-in-progress and cause connectivity issues for Dexcom transmitters. People install them and ask why they have connectivity issues.
cause: The releases are work-in-progress versions that have connectivity issues for Dexcom transmitters.
fix: Add a note to the releases warning about connectivity issues, or remove them from public access. The note added was: 'Connectivity issues for Dexcom transmitters have been reported. Do not install this build if you are using Dexcom hardware source'.
evidence_quote: I've added "Connectivity issues for Dexcom transmitters have been reported. Do not install this build if you are using Dexcom hardware source" to the description.
